ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 55% high-intensity (white/off-white) to 45% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigmentation at the median notch extending along the trailing edges; central lobe regions consist of high-intensity white/light-gray contiguous blobs with significant yellow-tan pixel clusters in mid-lobe zones; dense black mottling and vertical streaks concentrated on the distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 40 degrees; high bounding-box depth relative to fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-15 pixels, creating a jagged, irregular boundary isolated from the sea-state background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoid curvature; initial convex curve from the median notch transitioning to a linear-to-slightly-concave sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial clusters of high-intensity circular points (~3-8 pixel diameter) located primarily along the distal margins and trailing edge, consistent with barnacle attachment site geometry.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark-pixel linear disruptions; four parallel vertical rake marks on the far-left lobe tip and multiple elongated diagonal lines crossing the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on both lobe tips; extensive yellowish-tan pixel staining across the central ventral lobes likely representing diatom accumulation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity white 'splash' pattern on the inner right lobe surrounded by a dense field of black mottling.
